issues.issue: Whether the appellant is credible given contradictions and omissions
issues.applicant_position: Contradictions and omissions were explained by stress at the border and are not significant.
issues.result_quote: the RAD is of the opinion that the RPD's finding that the appellant lacks credibility is correct.

issues.issue: Whether the appellant's profile establishes a serious possibility of persecution if returned to Chad
issues.applicant_position: His political activism and documents show a well-founded fear of persecution in Chad.
issues.result_quote: it is clear that the appellant was unable to demonstrate that his profile was such that he would be subjected to a serious possibility

issues.issue: Whether documentary evidence and exhibits P-6 to P-8 can establish the fear
issues.applicant_position: Country documents and support letters establish the risk; the RPD should have given them weight.
issues.result_quote: the RAD is of the opinion that the RPD considered all of the evidence
